card_text: A short, choppy top worn forward over tight sides.

seo.title: Textured Crop in Carlsbad, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Textured crop and French crop haircuts in Carlsbad, NM: a short, choppy top worn forward with faded sides. See real crops and book on Booksy.

photo_alt.cut-textured-crop-low-fade: Textured crop from behind, choppy top brought forward into a short fringe over a fade to skin at the nape
photo_alt.cut-taper-textured-top: Short textured crop pushed forward and up, sharp front line-up and a taper to skin around the ear

paragraphs: Short on top, choppy on purpose, worn forward. The textured crop cuts the top so the hair breaks into pieces, then brings it forward into a short fringe over tight sides.

The back view shows a fuller version, with the fringe left heavy and the fade dropping to skin at the nape. The side view is shorter: pushed forward and up, with a squared line-up at the front and a taper around the ear.

blocks.heading: Messy or neat.
paragraphs: The French crop is the tidy relative: a short, blunt fringe across the front and a neat top. The textured crop is the lived-in one, with a broken-up fringe and more movement. Both sit forward and both take seconds to style, so the choice is about finish, not effort.

blocks.heading: Thick hair loves it.
paragraphs: Thick, straight or wavy hair that naturally wants to sit forward is the easiest fit. Because the crop brings hair over the front, it can also soften a higher hairline or a larger forehead.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: A crop is a precision cut. I clean up the neckline with the straight razor, then style it to show you how it sits forward.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: Same crop, plus beard work and the hot towel.

blocks.heading: Low effort day to day.
paragraphs: There isn't much to it between visits: push the top forward with your fingers and let the pieces fall where they want. The fade shows regrowth first, and once the fringe starts landing on your eyebrows, the shape is gone. That's when I'd like to see you back.

items.a: A short fringe, usually ending well above the eyebrows, cut as part of a crop. It can be blunt and straight or broken up for texture.

items.q: Does a textured crop work for thin hair?
items.a: Often, yes. The texture adds visual volume and the forward direction covers more of the front than a style pushed back.

items.q: What haircut suits a big forehead?
items.a: Styles that bring hair forward, like a crop or a fringe, cover part of the forehead. Styles that sweep hair back, like a slick back, show more of it.

items.q: How short are the sides on a textured crop?
items.a: Your call. A low fade or taper keeps it softer; a higher fade taken to skin makes the textured top stand out more.
